title: BiasLab: A Multilingual, Dual-Framing Framework for Robust Measurement of Output-Level Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Constructing mirrored probe pairs using a dual-framing scheme (affirmative and reverse assertions) with deterministic target substitution, evaluating outputs via fixed-choice Likert formats, and normalizing responses using an LLM-based judge to measure directional preference.
